entries.logic: Provides a static interface to switch between available User Agent Stylesheets (AtlantaFX). Encapsulates the switch/case logic for theme mapping.
entries.rationale: Maintains visual consistency across the entire application and allows for user-selectable themes without reloading the JVM.

entries.logic: Uses a strongly-typed Enum (ThemeType) to define supported themes, preventing invalid theme strings.
entries.rationale: Enables type-safety and IDE autocompletion for theme selection, reducing runtime errors.
